note: Living review of every repository proposed to Worldwright as of 2026-10-09. Evaluation pending is not dependency inclusion. Candidate integrated unverified is source on a draft branch, not shipped.

Promising pure-Rust B-Rep and STEP AP203; evaluate topology invariants, degenerate/boolean acceptance and independent STEP roundtrip corpus

Apache-2.0 allowed; compare 2D Bézier path calculations against Worldwright's existing drafting math before adding

Potential 3MF fabrication interchange; very small upstream, verify spec fidelity and dependencies

policy.license_policy: Allow legally compatible open-source code, including MIT, Apache-2.0, MPL-2.0 and dual-licensed crates; review GPL/LGPL/linking and redistribution obligations individually before adoption.
policy.technical_policy: Evaluate every shortlisted upstream. Prefer objectively better correctness/performance after fixtures and benchmarks; one implementation per mathematical operation, with adapters rather than parallel kernels.
policy.attribution: Keep upstream licenses/notices and source references; audit complete dependency graph and upstream license changes.
